## Additional Information

<!--
For a new task type, a real request/response sample is worth more than a
description: the SDK does not ship guessed field shapes. Until a shape is
confirmed, a type is reachable through Solve / CreateSyncTask with a plain map,
or through SolveAs with a struct of your own.

This module has no third-party dependencies and intends to keep it that way. A
proposal that needs one should say why the standard library cannot cover it.
